summary: In the United States, Felbamate has the strongest type of official warning for liver harm and severe blood problems, including aplastic anemia, which stops the body from making enough new blood cells [3][6]. Warnings also note that taking this drug can increase the risk of suicidal thoughts, while suddenly stopping it may cause seizures to happen more often [6]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received low risk scores for heart and liver harm [M].
